createdBy.description: Account that created the reservation (always the authenticated caller of POST /reservations; immutable). Visible to administrators; other callers only see it when it is their own id, null otherwise. Null also means system/unknown author.

createdBySelf.description: True when the caller created the reservation; returned to every caller.

client.description: Client: { id, name, email, phone } for non-administrators; full account for administrators.

employee.description: Employee: { id, name, profilePictureUrl } for non-administrators; administrators also get userId and the account.

animal.description: Animal; its owner is only included for administrators.

notificationStatus.description: Email notification result of write operations.

animalId.description: UUID of the animal belonging to the client.

ownerId.description: Client UUID when staff books on behalf of the owner. Omitted or equal to the caller: personal booking.

serviceId.description: Clinic service UUID (vc_services.id); must exist and be active. Its duration defines endAt.

employeeId.description: Employee profile UUID (vc_employees.id) to pre-assign; administrators only. Must be qualified for the service. Does not confirm.

startAt.description: Start instant, ISO-8601 with offset or Z (stored in UTC).

endAt.description: Optional. The server computes endAt = startAt + service durationMinutes. Non-administrators may only send that same value (400 otherwise); administrators may send a different end (override). Same clinic business day.

employeeId.description: Employee profile UUID (vc_employees.id), bookable on the reservation date.

startAt.description: New start instant, ISO-8601 with offset or Z.

endAt.description: New end instant, ISO-8601 with offset or Z. Optional: when omitted the reservation keeps its current duration (end - start), not the current service duration.

startAt.description: Start instant, ISO-8601 with an explicit offset or Z (stored in UTC).

endAt.description: End instant (exclusive), after startAt; may be on a later day.

employeeId.description: Employee profile (vc_employees.id) for an individual block; omitted or null = clinic-wide closure. Unknown: 404; inactive profile: 409.

startAt.description: Start instant, ISO-8601 with an explicit offset or Z (stored in UTC).

endAt.description: End instant (exclusive), after startAt; may be on a later day.

employeeId.description: Employee profile (vc_employees.id) for an individual block; omitted or null = clinic-wide closure. Unknown: 404; inactive profile: 409.

code.description: Unique uppercase code (letters, digits, underscores; starts with a letter). Immutable.

description.description: Trimmed; blank text is rejected (400), null clears it.

durationMinutes.description: Duration in minutes (5..1440, multiple of 5) used to compute endAt of new reservations. Changing it never alters existing reservations.

isActive.description: Inactive services cannot be booked; existing reservations and qualifications are kept.
